root_cause.text: The error path in create_space_info_sub_group() unconditionally calls kfree(sub_group) after btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() has already freed it through the kobject release callback, causing a double free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "When kobject_init_and_add() fails, the call chain is: create_space_info_sub_group() -> btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() -> kobject_init_and_add() -> failure -> kobject_put(&sub_group->kobj) -> space_info_release() -> kfree(sub_group). Then control returns to create_space_info_sub_group(), where: btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() returns error -> kfree(sub_group). Thus, sub_group is freed twice." The patch removes the extra kfree(sub_group) from the error path.
